changelog:
- Initial release of GEO 营销方案生成器 v1.0.0.
- Generates a complete AI-GEO marketing plan using the 360 智见 methodology.
- Outputs both a detailed Word "teleprompter" and a minimal, display-focused PPTX.
- Supports two input modes: detailed (user-provided keywords/plan) and light (auto-research + generated keywords).
- Built-in quality controls: strict data sourcing, de-AI-ified consultant tone, and detailed output validation.
- Output is suitable for client delivery, with clear separation between Word (detail) and PPT (summary).
summary: Generate a complete AI-GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) marketing plan for a client and deliver it as two artifacts: a Word document (the presenter's teleprompter, full detail) and a minimal display-only PPTX (10-12 slides, lots of white space, one core point per slide). Works in two input modes — detailed mode when the user supplies target keywords and/or a source plan, and light mode when the user supplies only a company website or basic company info, in which case the agent self-researches the industry and auto-generates about 10 core GEO demand keywords before proceeding. Use when a user asks to make or redo a GEO marketing plan, an AI 搜索优化方案, a 生成式引擎优化方案, or wants a client-ready Word plus PPT for GEO, especially built on the 360 智见 (360 Zhijian) GEO methodology.
